verdict.rationale: There is no cloud region or data-residency selector in the evidence. The only path to controlling where data lives is self-hosted CodeRabbit, which runs the review agent inside your own infrastructure [coderabbit-docs-18]. Self-hosted is listed as Enterprise-only, and on it you can opt out of all data retention [coderabbit-supp-2]. Missing for 10: selectable regions in CodeRabbit's cloud (e.g. EU/US), documented data-residency guarantees, residency options outside the Enterprise self-hosted tier, independent corroboration.
